<result>Done. The defaults/tunables registry (editor foundation workstream G) is built and self-verified.

## Files created (all under `runtime/tunables/`)

- **`tunable.ts`** — the registry + pure resolution. `TunableDef { id, label, base, presets: Record<string,number /*factor*/>, group, global?, keywords?, related? }`; `defineTunable()` with anti-collision (throws on duplicate id) and a guard that every tunable defines a `default` preset. `resolve(id, selection)` where a named preset → `factor × base`, a `{ custom: number }` override → raw, omitted → default. `overrideKey(material, variant, slot)` (+ `parseOverrideKey`). `searchTunables(query)` ranked: exact id (global wins ties) → id prefix → keyword → label → group → related. Active-selection state (`setSelection`/`getSelection`/`clearSelection`/`resolveCurrent`).
- **`events.ts`** — registers the workstream's editorbus event types via `defineEventType`: `tunable.override.set`, `tunable.override.clear`, `material.slot.fill`, `material.slot.reset`, `material.seed.roll`, `material.variant.select`. Dispatch helpers (`setTunableOverride`, `fillMaterialSlot`, …) set local state AND log onto the bus in one call, carrying `tunable`/`material` TargetRefs (material slot refs use the override key).
- **`host.ts`** — `__tunable_get(id) -> number` declared by augmenting `HostCalls`; `tunableGet()` calls the door when wired, gracefully falls back to `resolveCurrent()` (mirrors the editorbus local-fallback pattern).
- **`index.ts`** — re-exports the public surface.
- **`tunables.test.ts`** — micro-harness (shape cloned from `editorbus.test.ts`).

## Verification
`tools/esbuild` bundle clean, `tools/v8cli` run: **12 passed, 0 failed** — proves preset→value resolution, custom-override resolution, override keying, ranked search (global exact first, related after), and that an override edit broadcasts `tunable.override.set`/`material.slot.fill` on the bus with the right targets/payload.

## Integration notes
- The registry ships **no catalog** by design — like `event.ts`/`channel.ts`, systems register their own tunables once at module load. The editor cart / game module owns the actual `gravity`, `walkSpeed`, etc. data.
- Selection direction-of-truth: JS sets the active selection through `events.ts` (logged on the bus); Zig reads the resolved scalar back through `__tunable_get`. Workstream A's `__editor_bus_*` doors and the future Zig `__tunable_get` are the only host pieces still to land; nothing here blocks on them.
- Inspector consumes `default → named preset → custom override` via `resolve`; the globals palette consumes `searchTunables`; the Color Studio consumes `overrideKey` + the `material.slot.*` events.

## Contract gaps / notes
- I added two events beyond the three named in the brief (`tunable.override.clear`, `material.slot.reset`, `material.variant.select`) because the DESIGN_INTAKE Color Studio section explicitly lists reset/variant as part of the same family — additive, no seam change.
- Stayed strictly in `runtime/tunables/`; touched no shared files, build.zig, or git. The `HostCalls` augmentation is a `declare module` in my own file (the sanctioned per-workstream pattern), not an edit to `ffi.ts`.</result>
